A landed post contradicting itself on the same gap. FLAGGED: my smallest row. Severity is not a ground to drop it under an IDENTITY rule, but I record it as a concession candidate.

reconciliation.the_load_bearing_sentence: If compiler's 3 pre-publication rows are ADMITTED, my 16 published near-misses must be admitted too. If they are EXCLUDED, compiler's seed is 14. Applying the rule to one side only is the only outcome that is definitely wrong.
reconciliation.what_the_gap_is_NOT: It is not mainly a splitting difference. Measured on the seed's OWN carrier lists: 15 distinct carriers over 17 rows; 8 rows carry docs/ledger-tools/citecheck.py and 3 carry one prep doc. No carrier path lies in math's or silicon's lane, and there is no row for the clock cascade, the D2 grant/closure family, the control-traversal family, or the paper's own defects.
reconciliation.and_that_is_not_a_defect_in_the_seed: §3 says it outright: one seat's visible window is not a census and is not meant to be. The seed keyed the lane its author could see. The blind second pass is what makes that measurable instead of invisible — which is what the pipeline was built to produce.
